desc:
🥚 Steal eggs from the scariest monsters on the internet... and RUN! 😱

🏃 Grab an egg, escape the monster chasing you and bring it back to your base.
🐣 Hatch it and collect the creature inside!
💰 Every creature earns you money every second.
⚡ Get faster to unlock new worlds and rarer eggs.
🏏 Bonk other players with your bat to make them drop their eggs!

🌍 8 HORROR WORLDS: Dark Forest, The Yellow Halls, Craftworld, Cursed Circus, Haunted Asylum, Upside Town, Haunted Pizzeria and Cult Horror Killers.
👾 64 creatures to collect, from Common to ABYSSAL!

Can you steal them all without getting caught? 👀

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to get notified of new worlds and monsters!
